title: Ashbury Rewards Reconciliation Standard: Points after Folio Corrections
content:
When a folio correction removes eligible spend from a stay that was already credited to an Ashbury Rewards account, the points earned on the removed spend are taken back.

## Standard in force

1. **Earning transaction.** A reversal is posted only when the stay has an earning transaction.
2. **Corrections outside eligible spend.** Corrections that do not touch eligible spend, such as resort fee, tax, parking or late check-out adjustments, reverse nothing.
3. **Negative balance.** A reversal is posted even when it leaves the points balance below zero; a negative balance blocks redemptions and transfers until it is restored by later earning.

## Retired clause

> **No longer in force.** The clause "The points reversed are the base points and elite bonus posted for the stay less the base points and elite bonus that the stay earning rules give on the corrected eligible spend, with the same tier and brand rate, and the reversal names the base points earning transaction it reduces and records the eligible spend removed" is no longer in force. It is superseded by the current basis for the points reversed after a folio correction.

## Cases (hypothetical folios)

| Correction posted on the folio of a credited stay | Effect under this standard |
|---|---|
| A resort fee adjustment | Nothing reversed |
| A parking adjustment | Nothing reversed |
| A room-rate adjustment on a stay that has an earning transaction | Points earned on the removed spend taken back |
| Any correction on a stay that has no earning transaction | No reversal posted |

A reversal that takes a balance of 1200 points down by 1500 points leaves the balance at minus 300; until later earning restores it, the account can neither redeem nor transfer.

superseded_clauses: The points reversed are the base points and elite bonus posted for the stay less the base points and elite bonus that loyalty_stay_earning gives on the corrected eligible spend, with the same tier and brand rate, and the reversal names the stay_base earning transaction it reduces and records the eligible spend removed.
